subject: Implement summarize_run DBOS step
description:
In `capo/workflows/delegation.py`, implement `summarize_run` as a `@DBOS.step` that, on subprocess completion, makes a single LLM call (cheap model — `config.models.router`) to produce a one-paragraph summary of the run, then persists the summary on the `delegations.summary` column.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Step pulls last N chunks of `delegation_output` (configurable, default 200) and the brief from `delegations.brief_json`.
- [ ] Calls `config.models.router` with a short prompt; expects ≤ 250-token response.
- [ ] Persists result via the BEGIN IMMEDIATE retry helper.
- [ ] Step is idempotent via the idempotency framework (key derived from delegation_id + final returncode).

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Empty output (no chunks): summary is "Subagent produced no output."
- [ ] LLM call fails: summary set to "Summary unavailable: <error>"; workflow continues.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: prompt construction snapshot
• Integration: end-to-end run produces summary on row

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.6, 9.3
